name: page-header
title: Page header
description: A page header with the host's event and sponsor lockup, a small heading naming the game, the page title and an optional back control. The heading and title read as one heading, at level 1 by default or level 2 inside a host page. Long titles wrap. The back control uses Button and a left chevron, and reports a press through onBack. The host performs navigation; this component builds no URLs and makes no network requests.
docs: Pass title for the page name, heading for the game name and brand for a host-supplied image or mark. Pass onBack to show the back control; its label comes from page-header.backLabel in strings, defaulting to Back, or from backLabel. Use level={2} when the host supplies the main page heading. Style the existing brand, heading, label, decrement and chevron parts with data-gs-scope="page-header".
